original_test_intent: Trigger one approved GFX poison-consumption event and verify the BMC/Redfish out-of-band CPER pipeline records, exports and decodes the exact OAM, ODECC and GC poison fields.
original_method: Map GPU/OAM and BMC/SMC identities; pin tool/decoder/schema; use authenticated TLS Redfish and enumerate full preexisting entry set; FAE-approve -d0 -b2 -t8; inject once on dedicated SUT; identify the new entry by set/time/content; download/hash to controlled storage and transfer securely; decode and compare every required section/bank/code/type/severity/location; inspect GPU/BMC health and execute approved recovery.
manual_activity: AMD/BMC owners approve injection, endpoint/schema and decoded oracle; operator maintains isolated SUT/OOB recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Aligned in concept; exact target, secure endpoint and decoded fields are mandatory.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the source injection once after approval; enumerate Redfish JSON with authentication rather than grep, and hash the new attachment before decoding.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Device0/block2/type8 and all listed OAM/UMC/GC/code/severity fields retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a correlated injection-to-entry-to-hash-to-decoded-field transaction with authenticated transport.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, safe Redfish parsing/security, artifact integrity and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An index increment alone cannot prove content or correct source event.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Entry IDs may be concurrent/nonmonotonic; poison event can disrupt GPU and require host recovery.

project_override_considerations: Owner confirms whether UMC and GC bullets are separate CPER sections, exact Redfish resource for firmware, accepted TLS policy and event correlation window.
expected_evidence: New entry metadata and attachment hash

review_improvement: Makes the OOB CPER chain secure, identity-bound and content-verifiable instead of relying on a maximum ID and manual transfer.
independent_technical_reasoning: A CPER index increment proves only a new entry, not that it belongs to the injection. Correlation requires time/content plus a hashed attachment, and the decoded UMC/GC sections must be validated independently.
